title: AI in Network Operations: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: A fleet manager watches hundreds of vehicles. They spot trouble before it happens. An A I agent can do the same for a network.

scenes.heading: The autonomous fleet manager
scenes.narration: An agent follows a simple loop. It observes the network, using S N M P, NetFlow and logs. It builds a baseline of what normal looks like. It decides, and then it acts. A human stays in charge of the limits.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three traps. It makes decisions, not just scripts. It needs guardrails. It depends on good data.

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.cta: Try the Courseiva AI network ops lab
